# IFIB ACT SACT 24-28

Invitation for International Bidding (IFIB) for Contractor Support to Headquarter Supreme Allied Commander Transformation for NexGen M&S Multi-Domain Operations (MDO) Common Synthetic Environment (CSE) Demonstration, HQ SACT, Norfolk, Virginia, U.S.A.

**Type of Contract**: Firm Fixed Price (FFP) Deliverables.

**Period of Performance**:

8 July 2024 – 19 July 2024.

**Bid closing date**: Bids shall be received at HQ SACT, Purchasing and Contracting Office, no later than **12 Jun 2024, 0900 hours, Eastern Daylight Time, Norfolk**, Virginia, USA. No bids shall be accepted after this time and date.
